snapshot.name: Hindustan Aeronautics Ltd
snapshot.about: Hindustan Aeronautics Ltd (HAL), a 71.64% Government-owned Maha-Ratna CPSE, designs, manufactures, upgrades and provides lifecycle MRO for aircraft, helicopters, aero -engines, avionics /accessories and aerostructures, principally for India’s armed forces. [1]

narrative_vs_numbers.management_says: Management frequently claims they maintain margins around 30% to 31%.
narrative_vs_numbers.numbers_say: Operating margins fluctuate heavily, often dropping to 24% in non-Q4 quarters before spiking in March quarters.

promises.credibility: Management guidance tends to be overly optimistic on stable margins, while actual operational profitability shows high seasonal volatility with massive spikes only in the March ending quarters.

bull: Strong returns with ROCE at 32.0% and ROE at 24.0% demonstrate high capital efficiency.
Profit is outgrowing revenue, highlighted by a 3-year PAT CAGR of 16% versus revenue CAGR of 7%.
Robust cash generation is shown by a 5-yr free cash flow of ₹42,534 Cr with zero negative years.
bear: Working capital is stretching significantly, with the cash conversion cycle increasing from 484 to 788 days.
Guidance was missed as Sep 2026 EBITDA margin dropped to 23% against the 30% to 31% target.
Latest quarter Sep 2026 operating margin declined by -0.7pp YoY to stand at 22.8%.
